name: Imperiosa

abilityDetails.Fractured Power Bar: Şampiyon, elindeki güç barına göre farklı özel saldırı türlerini belirli olasılıklarla kullanır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Pierce: Blok Nüfuzunu ve Zırh Nüfuzunu belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Corrosion: Aktifken fiziksel hasar verir; hedefin zırhı azaldıkça bu hasar %100'e kadar artar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Dövüşe %75 güçle başlar ama güç kilidi altındadır (combo bitirme/ağır saldırı/intercept ile 4sn açılır). E3'ü corrosion uygular, ondan kaçın. Bloktan çok can gider (fury+penetrasyon), nötralize edilirse pasife döner. E2'si etrafına tuzak koyar (6sn köklenme, siperlenemez) — asla E2 kullanmasına izin verme. Güç kontrolcüleri en önemlisi.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Eidol Physiology - Always Active
content: Imperiosa is a Cosmic Eidol and thus has a Fractured Power Bar and is Immune to Bleed, Disintegrate, and Power Drain effects.
Imperiosa begins each fight with 75% of their Max Power. Their Combat Power Rate cannot be reduced below its starting value.

While neither Champion has 3 Bars of Power or is using a Special Attack or Striker, Imperiosa is Passively Special Locked and loses 2% of their Max Power per second. This falls and rises by up to 2% the more Imperiosa does or does not hit the Opponent or their Block.
When either Champion lands or Blocks an Intercept or a Combo-Ending or Heavy Attack, gain Immunity to Special Lock for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Synthect Buffs
content: When Imperiosa loses Power, if it causes them to go to or below a certain threshold, they gain a corresponding non-stacking Buff:
0 Bars of Power: Power Gain Buff granting 4% of Max Power per second. While active, Power can't increase via non-personal sources.
Synthect Buffs last 16 seconds but are paused while Imperiosa's Power is below the triggering threshold.
As a Defender, when a Synthect Buff fails or is removed, it is replaced with an identical Passive with 80% potency.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, refresh up to 3 Damaging Debuffs on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Places a Synthect Trap in front of Imperiosa lasting 6 seconds. While in the Trap, the Opponent is Passively Rooted.
While Rooted this way, the Opponent suffers 150% reduced Stun Ability Accuracy and becomes significantly more likely to Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Corrosion Debuff dealing [42,040] Physical Damage over 20 seconds, paused during Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Ascendant Empress
content: Synthect Passives can trigger as an Attacker, but at [10 - 30]% potency, and not from Nullify, Stagger, or Fateseal.
When Imperiosa is Auto-Blocked, they trigger their Synthect Trap directly under the Opponent for 3 seconds as well as each Synthect Passive.
